sections.A: Spondylolysis mein vertebra ke ek patle hisse (pars) mein crack ya stress injury hoti hai. Spondylolisthesis mein ek vertebra neeche wale par aage khisak jata hai.
sections.B: Naujawan khiladi: kamar ko peeche jhukane ya ghumane par dard, aaraam se behtar. Bare umar mein: kamar dard, kabhi taang mein symptoms.
sections.C: Kaun sa khel ya baar baar movement, training ka load haal mein barha ya nahi, aur kya peeche jhukne se dard aata hai.
sections.D: Posture aur chaal dekhein, vertebrae par ungli se step dhoondein (na mile to bhi khisakna ho sakta hai), aur neuro exam.
sections.E: Koi clinical test pars ka crack confirm nahi karta; diagnosis doctor imaging se karta hai. Tests sirf shak ko mazboot karte hain.
sections.F: Aam kamar dard, facet joint ka dard aur doosri wajahein table mein hain.
sections.G: Saddle sunn-pan, peshab ya pakhane ki tabdeeli, barhti kamzori ya foot drop: foran referral.
sections.H: Naujawan khiladi ko peeche jhukne par dard aur test positive ho to imaging ke liye doctor ke paas bhejein, aur us dauraan load kam karein.
sections.I: Hip aur thoracic mobilisation, aur hamstring aur hip flexor stretching kamar ka load kam karte hain.
sections.J: Abdominal bracing, dead bug, side plank aur dheere dheere taaqat aur khel ki taraf wapsi.
sections.K: Garmi aur TENS optional. Brace sirf doctor ki hidayat par.
sections.L: Samjhayein ke is finding ka matlab kya hai aur kya nahi. Pehle dard wali activities kam, phir trunk aur hip ki rehab, phir khel par wapsi.
sections.M: Dard, extension tolerance, trunk endurance, neuro status aur khel ka load track karein. Naya nerve sign aaye to dobara refer.
sections.N: 15 saal ka fast bowler bowling ke waqt kamar dard mehsoos karta hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, load control aur active trunk aur hip rehab.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
